\section*{Credited prior work}

The results of this paper build on the following established work. Each
entry names an established result as it is used here and cites its sources.

\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}
\item Finite Markov first-hit theory, qualitative reachability, closed classes, strong lumpability, and product preorders~\cite{pwkemeny1976finite,BaierKatoen2008,pwdavey2002introduction}.
\item Newman's lemma, abstract rewriting, and observability of consistent states~\cite{Newman1942,BaaderNipkow1998}.
\item Scheduler-quantified reachability for finite Markov decision processes and probabilistic model checking~\cite{BaierKatoen2008,pwbianco1995model}.
\item Stability moduli, metric subregularity, approximate inverse systems, and telescoping bounds~\cite{DontchevRockafellar2014,MardesicRubin1989}.
\item Weighted abstract reduction systems, derivational complexity, amortized potential bounds, fairness, and self-stabilization~\cite{pwterese2003term,pwhofbauer1989termination,pwtarjan1985amortized,pwfrancez1986fairness,Dijkstra1974}.
\item Well-founded descent and weak fairness in finite asynchronous rewriting~\cite{BaaderNipkow1998,pwfrancez1986fairness}.
\end{itemize}
